newsitem.title: HONG KONG: South China Ind names chief executive. [CORRECTED 03:20 GMT]
newsitem.headline: South China Ind names chief executive. [CORRECTED 03:20 GMT]

text.p: South China Industries Ltd and its 75 percent owned Wah Shing International Holdings Ltd said on Friday they had appointed Christina Cheung as chief executive.

Cheung is vice chairman of South China Industries and deputy chairman of Wah Shing, the companies said in separate statements (corrects to clarify that Cheung is still vice chairman of South China Industries and deputy chairman of Wah Shing).

The companies said Cheung was replacing Hui Wai Yin, who resigned as chief executive of both companies and other directorships with South China Holdings Ltd and South China Strategic Ltd with effect from December 31, 1996.
Wah Shing also said it had appointed George So as executive director.
